jobs.occupation: Join Native Nanny – International Childcare Opportunities in Frankfurt an Main (Kinderbetreuer/in)
jobs.description:
At Native Nanny, we specialize in international childcare placements across Germany. We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.

We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Frankfurt and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!

Your Responsibilities

- Provide loving, attentive, and safe care for children.
- Organize and structure daily routines with age-appropriate activities such as games, creative play, reading, or homework support.
- Accompany children to and from school, nursery, or extracurricular activities.
- Handle light, child-related housekeeping: meal prep, tidying play areas, laundry, etc.

Your Profile

- Experience with children or babies is essential. A background in education or childcare is a strong advantage.
- You’re caring, empathetic, and genuinely enjoy working with children.
- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.
- You have a friendly, open, and professional attitude.
- You speak English, French, Italian, or another common European language fluently.

Why Join Us?

- Put your cultural background and language talents to meaningful use in a childcare role.
- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.
- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.

If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!

jobs.occupation: Product Owner, Fertility - Integrated Health & Medicines   (all genders) (Product Owner)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

This position can be filled in Germany (Darmstadt), Switzerland (Eysins) or the US (Boston)

Your role

As an experienced digital health product leader, you will serve as Product Owner for innovative solutions within the Fertility Therapeutic Area.

You are accountable for translating business, medical, patient, and user needs into scalable, high-impact digital health solutions that address meaningful patient and healthcare professional needs. Operating within a regulated pharmaceutical environment, you combine strategic thinking with strong execution ownership across the full solution lifecycle, from concept and value definition through development, launch, and continuous improvement.

You shape the therapeutic area digital health roadmap, define solution value propositions and target outcomes, and support business case development, ensuring solutions are user-centric, compliant, and aligned with IH&M and Therapeutic Area priorities.

Working closely with Core Team Leads, UX, engineering, delivery teams, and business stakeholders, you drive effective prioritization, implementation, validation, and continuous evolution of digital solutions while balancing user value, business impact, technical feasibility, and compliance requirements.

You will:

- Drive the delivery of differentiated user-centric and value-driven digital health solutions that address meaningful patient and HCP needs across the IVF ecosystem.
- Shape the digital health roadmap and product strategy, ensuring alignment between therapeutic area priorities, solution value propositions, development decisions, and measurable impact.
- Own product prioritization and backlog management, making clear, value-based trade-offs across user needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and compliance.
- translate digital health concepts into scalable solutions, working closely with internal and external stakeholders and continuously optimizing products to maximize adoption, engagement, and long-term impact.
- Drive continuous learning and improvement, using user feedback, product performance, and real-world insights to evolve solutions and demonstrate value.

Who you are

- A university degree in Life Sciences, Digital Health, Healthcare Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field (PMP certification preferred).
- 7+ years of working experience in a related field.
- You bring proven experience in digital health product management, including product definition, backlog management, software development lifecycle, and solution delivery within regulated healthcare, pharmaceutical, or health-tech environments.
- You are a strong strategic thinker and translate complex business, medical, patient, and user needs into actionable product strategies, roadmaps, and business cases, and you are confident making value-based prioritization decisions across user impact, technical feasibility, and compliance.
- You have a strong user-centric mindset and a solid understanding of patient and healthcare professional needs and engagement principles in pharmaceutical or healthcare settings.
- You bring excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, working effectively across UX, engineering, data, commercial, medical, and vendor teams to translate needs into feasible digital solutions.
- You have working knowledge of regulated digital health environments, including data privacy, quality, cybersecurity, and relevant regulatory expectations.
- You have strong communication and influencing skills across technical and non-technical audiences, and practical experience managing external vendors and digital solution delivery partners.
- Familiarity with the IVF ecosystem, Women’s Health, or adjacent healthcare domains is a plus and will strengthen your application.
- Fluency in English

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

- Familiarity with tools such as Power BI, project portfolio management systems
- Fluency in English (oral and written), German language is highly beneficial
- Strategic thinking and prioritization and ability to operate in ambiguity and drive alignment
- Strong communication, influencing, and facilitation skills

Job Description

jobs.occupation: Sr. Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) - SiC (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Abut the role

As a Senior Product Application Engineer (m/f/d), you will work on developing and validating advanced SiC-based solutions, turning cutting-edge semiconductor technology into real-world applications. You will collaborate with global teams, support customers, and help drive new products to market, combining hands-on engineering with strong application insight.

About us

Job description

In order to support our team Customs, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

Customs Manager (d/f/m)

In this role, you will support the strategic alignment of our customs processes and systems, ensuring the seamless flow of our internal and external international supply chain as we pioneer the future of sustainable aerospace. Join our Customs team to navigate the complexities of global trade and play a key role in optimizing our customs landscape to drive operational excellence.

Your location

You will be working at the largest German production site for commercial aircrafts situated in Hamburg (the position can also be based in Bremen or Augsburg). Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras : Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave; work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Customs Strategy & Compliance:

- Ensure compliant customs processes and serve as the primary customs contact for Airbus Aerostructures GmbH.
- Coordinate customs activities across all Airbus Aerostructures GmbH locations, maintaining alignment with customs authorities.
- Coordinate the company internal interdependencies and foster the customs network.
- Perform internal customs audits, manage quarterly accounting, and lead negotiations regarding customs permits and processes.
- Initiate customs projects for cost optimization and manage risks and opportunities in coordination with Risk Management.

Customs Systems & Data Management:

- Oversee the development, implementation, and optimization of the customs system (SAP-GTS) at Airbus Aerostructures GmbH, including managing system changes and user testing.
- Generate and report customs statistics and KPIs for Airbus Aerostructures GmbH, Airbus, and customs authorities.

Operational Control & Advisory:

- Control operational customs areas, manage external customs agents, and ensure contractual compliance.
- Conduct training for staff on customs regulations and provide guidance to departments such as Purchasing and Logistics.

Your Profile

- Education: Bachelor’s or Diploma degree in Business, Procurement, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or Commercial Apprenticeship with additional relevant qualification.
- Experience: Several years of relevant professional experience in customs and foreign trade.
- Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP (ideally the GTS module) and Google G-Suite.
- Languages: Professional proficiency in English (minimum C1 level) and native or bilingual proficiency in German (C2 level).
- Soft Skills: Strong communication, conflict-management, and teamwork skills, with an autonomous and reliable work style.

jobs.occupation: Internship Business Management Support (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our operations team, Airbus Operations is looking for an

Intern (d/f/m) for Business Management Support

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized, and motivated Business Management Support Intern (d/f/m) to join our operations team. In this role, you will work closely with Airframe Project Managers (APMs) & Offer Managers (OMs), to support project definition, milestone execution, offer management, and financial tracking. This internship offers hands-on experience in corporate project management frameworks, financial planning (DBF), and operational execution.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 6 to 9 months (this will be a combination of a mandatory internship of 6 months and a voluntary internship of 3 months as a maximum)

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Direct Exposure: Practical experience with industry-standard project management methodologies and governance processes
- Financial Insight: Hands-on involvement in project-level financial tracking and corporate financial alignment
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Direct interaction with key stakeholders across project management, operations, and commercial offer teams.
- Mentorship: Professional development support and continuous guidance from experienced operations managers and project leads.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Business & Project Management Support:

- Support Airframe Project Managers (APMs) in defining project scopes, objectives, and deliverables with sufficient detail.
- Track project progress against established timelines and key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Assist APMs in planning, coordinating, and executing uPDP milestones.

Offer Management & Administrative Support:

- Collaborate with Offer Managers (OMs) to gather, organize, and validate inputs required for commercial offers.
- Perform administrative tracking of new offer inflow requests to ensure timely processing and routing.
- Maintain central records and dashboards for incoming business inquiries and project proposals.

Financial & Performance Tracking:

- Support the Upgrade team in establishing and monitoring project-level financial trackers.
- Monitor budget vs. actuals, variance analysis, and expenditure trends across active projects.
- Maintain alignment between project-level financial tracking .

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student d/f/m) in the area of Business Administration, Business Management, Project Management, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- Fluent in German and English.
- Proficiency in Google tools (sheets, slides, docs)
- Advanced Google sheets skills (data organization, lookup formulas, basic financial modeling) preferred.
- Familiarity with project management tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

The role leads manufacturing IT, factory digitalization, infrastructure, workplace services, and end-user support, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT services for a 24/7 semiconductor manufacturing environment.

Factory IT Leadership

- Lead all IT activities supporting the Hamburg manufacturing site and act as the primary IT partner for site leadership, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Facilities.

Manufacturing Systems & Factory Digitalization

- Lead lifecycle management, upgrades, and modernization of manufacturing systems.
- Drive factory automation, equipment integration, robotics, and smart manufacturing initiatives.

Infrastructure & Workplace Services

Service Management, Security & Compliance

Leadership & Vendor Management

- Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Coordinate resource planning and prioritization across internal team and external partners for projects and business support.

What you will need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Minimum 7 years of relevant leadership experience in Manufacturing IT, Factory IT, or industrial environments
- Strong knowledge of MES, CIM, factory automation, equipment integration, and manufacturing operations.

jobs.description:
About ficonTEC:

ficonTEC Service GmbH is an innovative high-tech company that has quickly established itself in a highly specialized market since 2001. With continuous growth and innovative development, we are a recognized market leader in the automated assembly and testing of optoelectronic components and (hybrid) photonic devices. Our company develops advanced solutions such as high-precision die bonding, fiber alignment, and laser soldering systems, which are critical for manufacturing cutting-edge photonic devices like LiDAR sensors, high-speed data transceivers, and silicon photonics. These technologies are paving the way for advancements in telecommunications, autonomous vehicles, and medical diagnostics.

Our company-wide goal is to set up top-notch technology that facilitates our customers from around the world in building tomorrow’s optoelectronic devices. We believe in equal opportunity, with employees committed to diversity and inclusion, offering a vibrant working environment.

Are you looking for a job in a forward-looking industry? Then become part of our strong and experienced team as a:

Would you like to commission state-of-the-art automation systems, solve technical challenges, and ensure that software and hardware work together seamlessly? Then join our team as:

Technician / Engineer Commissioning (m/f/d) Special Purpose Machinery

Your Challenge::
You bring our highly automated special-purpose machines to life.

From initial power-up to final customer acceptance, you will take technical responsibility for commissioning our systems and ensure seamless interaction between hardware and software. Working with state-of-the-art motion control, vision, and automation technologies, you will ensure that all machine functions operate reliably, safely, and in accordance with technical specifications.

You will analyze complex technical systems, solve electrical and mechanical challenges, and support each machine through to the next project phase

Your responsibilities:

- Commissioning and parameterization of I/O, vision, and motion control systems
- Configuration and adjustment of machine processes within our in-house control software (PCM)
- Initialization, testing, and optimization of machine functions
- Execution and verification of safety functions
- Electrical and mechanical troubleshooting of complex automation systems
- Analysis and resolution of hardware and software issues
- Performing software, functional, and system tests
- Ensuring machine performance in accordance with technical specifications
- Documentation of results and structured handover to subsequent project phase
What Makes This Role Exciting
You will experience firsthand how individual components are transformed into highly precise production systems used by leading technology companies worldwide.

From day one, you will take responsibility, work on sophisticated automation solutions, and see the direct impact of your work every day. Each successfully commissioned machine contributes directly to our customers' success and to the advancement of future-oriented technologies.
Your Profile::

- Successfully completed further training as a certified technician or master craftsman, or a degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a comparable field
- Ideally, initial professional experience in commissioning, automation technology, or special-purpose machinery
- Solid knowledge of electrical engineering, measurement and control technology, or drive systems
- Strong technical understanding of complex machinery and mechatronic systems
- Structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong analytical skills and enthusiasm for troubleshooting
- German and English language skills, both written and spoken (minimum level B2)

Your Benefits:

- Permanent employment contract
- Excellent long-term career prospects
- Flexible working hours
- Childcare subsidy for children up to the age of three
- Company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits
- Corporate fitness program
- Comprehensive onboarding program and individual support
- Annual employee development reviews with a focus on personal and professional growth
- Employee discount programs (e.g., City for Two, Benefits App)
- Regular company events, including summer parties, Christmas celebrations, and B2Run events

Interested? :
Become part of our team and help shape the next generation of highly automated production systems. 

We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV, cover letter, and relevant certificates. 

You can find out more about ficonTEC here: 
www.ficontec.com

The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

Our offer

Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form:

https://bewerbermanagement.net/67hhg

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. TheGWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expresslyencouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail:

jancillie.louw@gwdg.de ).
